notes.title: Drone: Remote Tactical Warfare Released!
notes.notes:
Hi all,
Drone is finally out! This is just the beginning - get on board and help guide the dev process. Updates will be regular and your opinion matters. Thanks to everyone who helped in pre-release. 

Infamus Entertainment

notes.title: Release delayed until 19 July 1900 (US PT)
notes.notes:
Hi all, 
The release of Drone: Remote Tactical Warfare has been delayed due to an unforeseen admin issue (the review process is taking a long time!). This is nobody's fault and will push back the release date by only 48 hours. Thanks for being patient. 

Infamus Entertainment
